metadata.description: Parameters for the ONE-CLICK Sentinel Destination variant (sentinel-destination-with-app.azuredeploy.json), which ALSO creates the Entra app registration via an Azure deploymentScript and stores the client secret in Key Vault. PREREQUISITE: managedIdentityResourceId must be a user-assigned managed identity that already holds a directory role able to create app registrations (e.g. Application Administrator). The deployer needs Owner (or Contributor + User Access Administrator) on the resource group. For most deployments prefer the standard template + scripts/new-abstract-sentinel-app.{sh,ps1}.
